slides.title: Sound like [[you]]?
items: Curled up on the couch all day

slides.title: Cold days, [[fewer]] steps
slides.body: When it's chilly and dark early, we skip walks and errands. Fewer steps means your body sits still for most of the day.

slides.title: Hunched up from the [[chill]]
slides.body: In the cold, we tense up and pull our shoulders in. Add long hours at a desk or on the sofa, and your body can feel stiff.

items.head: Roll your shoulders
items.sub: Ten slow circles, back and forth

items.head: Reach up and side bend
items.sub: Hold each side for a few breaths

items.head: March in place
items.sub: Two minutes while the kettle boils

slides.title: Stretch [[checklist]]
slides.note: Lifestyle tips only. If it lasts, talk to a professional.

slides.title: Stay cozy, keep [[moving]]!
slides.body: Save, share and tell a friend

caption:
Too cold to go outside today? 🧘

Chilly, dark days mean fewer steps, and we tend to hunch up and sit still for hours.
Try three small habits starting today:
Roll your shoulders · Reach up and side bend · March in place
